name: How long does a typical kitchen refresh project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen refresh project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen refresh depends on the scope of work. Minor updates like painting cabinets and replacing hardware might take as little as 1-2 weeks. If your project includes new countertops, a backsplash, sink replacement, and minor electrical or plumbing updates, it could extend to 3-5 weeks. Projects requiring custom cabinet refinishing or specialized material sourcing may take longer. We provide a detailed timeline upfront after assessing your specific project requirements and material availability to ensure clarity.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen refresh typically takes 1-5 weeks, depending on the scope of work and material availability.
